DESCRIPTION:
Evaluate producer guarantees against a complete consumer contract

USAGE:
    packata contract satisfies <PRODUCER> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    packata contract satisfies producer.odcs.yaml --consumer consumer.odcs.yaml 
--format json

ARGUMENTS:
    <PRODUCER>    Complete producer contract: local file, HTTP(S) descriptor, or
                  supported archive                                             

OPTIONS:
                                    DEFAULT                                     
    -h, --help                                     Prints help information      
        --output-format <FORMAT>    text           Output representation: text  
                                                   or json                      
    -o, --output <PATH>                            Write the result to a new    
                                                   file instead of stdout       
        --consumer <SOURCE>                        Complete consumer contract in
                                                   the same native standard as  
                                                   the producer                 
        --input-format <FORMAT>     auto                                        
        --format <FORMAT>                          Alias for --output-format:   
                                                   text or json                 
        --unknown <POLICY>          unsatisfied    Gate unresolved findings:    
                                                   unsatisfied (exit 1), ignore,
                                                   or error (exit 2). Findings  
                                                   remain Unknown               
        --quiet                                    Suppress all output while    
                                                   preserving exit behavior
